metadata.title: BIRTHS, DEATHS AND MARRIAGES REGISTRATION ACT, 1972

frontmatter.p: AN ACT TO AMEND AND EXTEND THE BIRTHS AND DEATHS REGISTRATION ACTS, 1863 TO 1952, AND TO PROVIDE FOR CERTAIN AMENDMENTS TO ENACTMENTS RELATING TO THE REGISTRATION OF MARRIAGES. [29th November, 1972]

sect.p: the Acts means the Births and Deaths Registration Acts, 1863 to 1952;
health board means a health board established under the Health Act, 1970.
